name: dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-codex
description: Local Wallpaper Engine video and Scene backgrounds for the Codex desktop app.

interface.shortDescription: Use Wallpaper Engine media as a Codex window skin.
interface.longDescription: Developed from the original DSH Wallpaper Engine integration and rewritten for Codex. Discovers local Wallpaper Engine projects and embeds compressed video, decoded animation frames, or project previews behind the Codex interface through a reversible local debug bridge. CDP access is restricted to the exact Codex main-page URL and excludes browser or login pages. It does not change the Windows desktop wallpaper or patch Codex application files.
defaultPrompt: Show Wallpaper Engine projects I can use as a Codex skin.
Apply a Wallpaper Engine background to this Codex window.
Remove the Codex skin and restore the normal interface.
